claims.text: Distorted information in AIGC can be classified into 8 first-level error types: Overfitting, Logic errors, Reasoning errors, Mathematical errors, Unfounded fabrication, Factual errors, Text output errors, and Other errors.
The first-level error types of distorted information in AIGC are further subdivided into 31 second-level error types.
Empirical content analysis on ChatGPT question-and-answer instances can refine and validate a categorization scheme for distorted information in AIGC.

evidence.description: The findings identified 8 first-level error types: “Overfitting”; “Logic errors”; “Reasoning errors”; “Mathematical errors”; “Unfounded fabrication”; “Factual errors”; “Text output errors”; and “Other errors”.
The first-level error types were further subdivided into 31 second-level error types.
Utilizing ChatGPT as a case study, empirical content analysis was conducted on 243 instances of distorted information comprising both questions and answers to refine and validate the category list.

methodologies.name: Empirical Content Analysis
methodologies.description: Three coders interpreted 243 instances of ChatGPT distorted information (questions and answers), encoding error points using a predefined coding scheme through multiple rounds of pre-coding and test coding.
datasets: 243 instances of distorted information collected from ChatGPT
conditions: Multiple rounds of pre-coding and test coding
